## Problem

What problem does this solve? "I want to do X but the scanner
currently makes me do Y."

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you think about? Why this one?

## Use case

A real-world scenario where this would be helpful. If you have a
sample input (SARIF / .tf / YAML), include it.

## Implementation notes

Optional. If you have ideas about how this would be implemented,
share them. Otherwise, leave this section empty.
